labels.budget_before_valid_compute: Turn exhaustion; no valid computation executed
labels.budget_with_observed_policy_error: Turn exhaustion; a valid computation chose a wrong policy
labels.budget_with_valid_compute_no_observed_po: Turn exhaustion; valid partial computation, no observed policy error
labels.success_after_discarded_policy_error: Numeric success; compliant submitted ancestry after an earlier policy error
labels.success_clean_policy_history: Numeric success; all executed policies correct
labels.wrong_answer_with_unexpected_tool_error: Wrong answer; unexpected tool error also observed
labels.wrong_answer_without_unexpected_tool_err: Wrong answer; no unexpected tool error

note: Descriptive partitions, not causal first-failure attribution. Wrong-answer branches concern submitted numeric results; rejected calls can coexist with policy errors. Zero valid compute is not evidence of correct operation choice. Original numeric evaluator and every outcome are unchanged.
